title: Cats but better
description: This mod adds various cat-based items to the game such as catmint, and cat based weapons, and a new cat mob!
body:
**This mod is no longer being worked on.**

This mod aims to enchance and add on to cats.
Note that this is my first mod!

# **About Cats but better:**
Cats but better enchances the game by adding cat-based items, achivements and more to the game!

![Cats but better title screen of a cat lying down near a patch of flowers.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6bcd7a71c8ce5648681cdcdd50cc2c4b01e7e19d.png)

# **What this adds:**
Catmint - a herb that can be eaten for a boost, and found anywhere on land
Cat-based items, such as the catmint staff!
Cat treat- A item the player can eat for a boost.
2 unlockable achievements.

Currently its not much, as this is my first mod.




# **Why would should you download this?:**
If you download this, your supporting a small creator on the path of programming, as well as getting the mod itself! This mod offers cat-based items that you wont find in any other mod you may come across!

Thank you for checking out my project.
